invariants.description: charge balance with no channels or axon connected: Cm (V - V0) + C_sensed (V_sensed - V_sensed0) = +1e6 I_in t (pF mV = 1e-15 C, nA s = 1e-9 C)

bc_sweep.rationale: Constants by factors 0.5-2; the diameter d by the cube roots of those factors, so the volume k_V d^3 spans 0.5-2 of its value (as Vol did) and the area k_A d^2 0.63-1.59; k_A and c_m scale Cm by 0.5-2 (as Cm did).
